The answer is:
No, protein Q14774 does not have more than 537 residues. The canonical sequence (isoform 1) has 488 residues (and isoform 2 has 285 residues).
And the residue count is 488.

In `concerns`:
There is a clear discrepancy in the UniProt REST API JSON:
The JSON endpoint reports `sequence.length: 586` and `sequence.molWeight: 60947`, which does not match the actual amino acid sequence provided in the same JSON object (`sequence.value`, which is 488 residues long and corresponds to ~50,854 Da). This 586 length corresponds to an erroneous N-terminally extended translation (e.g. GenBank BAB55364.1 / RefSeq NP_001382457.1) noted in UniProt'</execute></solution>
